title: The World Starts Tonight
notes: Warm country-pop melodies and dramatic singing meet guitar-led arrangements and arranged strings.

title: Natural Force
notes: Country-rock backing foregrounds Tyler’s newly roughened voice on direct ballads and heartbreak anthems.

title: Diamond Cut
scene: Late-1970s British country-pop moving towards pop-rock
notes: Polished pop-rock retains country guitars, adding soulful ballads, saxophone and occasional synthesizer.

title: Goodbye to the Island
notes: Bluesy rock performances and expressive ballads broaden the final RCA-era album’s sound.
